articles.title: Gas Prices Drop in June, But Experts Say the Relief Won’t Last
articles.summary: U.S. consumer prices fell in June because energy costs went down. The average gallon of gas dropped to $3.85 from $4.07 last month. But fighting in the Strait of Hormuz could push prices back up soon.

articles.title: UK Wasted £10 Billion on Bad PPE That Failed to Protect Nurses and Doctors
articles.summary: A report says the UK wasted nearly £10 billion on masks, gowns, and gloves that didn’t protect health workers during the pandemic. The country’s emergency stockpile was almost empty when COVID hit, and rushed buying led to huge mistakes.

articles.title: Why a Tiny Waterway Is Causing a Giant Headache for the U.S.
articles.summary: The Strait of Hormuz is only 21 miles wide, but 20% of the world's oil passes through it. Now, hidden missiles and drones are keeping tankers away, and experts say it might take tens of thousands of troops to fix.
